# DeepSilencer conversion status

Paper2Agent result: **partial**.

The `skill/deepsilencer-paper/` directory contains the reviewed paper-reading package and associated CSV datasets. Open its `SKILL.md` to begin.

No MCP component is included because the inspected authors' repository contains a README and three datasets, with no DeepSilencer source code or trained model artifacts. Prediction, training, evaluation, clean-runtime tests, and MCP ZIP acceptance could not be performed. A paper-reading conversion does not reproduce the paper's numerical results.

Sources: arXiv:2503.04200v1 and https://github.com/BlackCattt9/DeepSilencer at commit `0e43907220e61e75c414ac3f9fcab4ee80c9ae82`.

The full local project retains review evidence outside this portable delivery. The public repository provides integrity verification and the independent source-scan report. Original authorship and applicable reuse terms remain in effect.
